title: Initialize Cargo workspace with all crate stubs
description:
Create Cargo.toml workspace manifest and stub crates: kithd (bin), kithctl (bin), kith-core, kith-store, kith-jmap, kith-chat, kith-peer, kith-tslocal, kith-events, kith-attach. Each stub compiles (empty lib.rs for libs, fn main(){} for bins) with correct inter-crate dependency declarations. Also create web/ and migrations/ directories with .gitkeep. cargo build must succeed from workspace root.

Crate dependency graph:
- kith-core: no kith deps; serde, serde_json
- kith-store: kith-core; rusqlite (bundled feature)
- kith-jmap: kith-core
- kith-tslocal: kith-core
- kith-events: kith-core
- kith-attach: kith-core, kith-store
- kith-chat: kith-core, kith-store, kith-jmap
- kith-peer: kith-core, kith-store
- kithctl (bin): kith-core, kith-tslocal
- kithd (bin): kith-core, kith-store, kith-jmap, kith-chat, kith-peer, kith-tslocal, kith-events, kith-attach; axum, tokio, serde, serde_json, rustls, ulid

License: AGPL-3.0-or-later in all Cargo.toml files. Edition 2021. Resolver 2. Cargo.lock must NOT be in .gitignore (binary project — commit the lock file).
